282	    # --- request assembly -------------------------------------------------------------------
283	    def _request(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
284	                 tool_choice: dict[str, Any] | str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
285	        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
286	            "model": self.model_id, "messages": cast(list[ChatCompletionMessageParam], messages),
287	            "max_completion_tokens": self.max_output_tokens, "store": False, "service_tier": "default"}
288	        # gpt-6-luna reasons by default, and its Chat Completions endpoint takes function calls only without reasoning:
289	        # whatever effort is asked for, a request that reaches this endpoint says none (asked-for efforts use `_responses`).
290	        effort = "none" if is_luna(self.model_id) else self.reasoning_effort
291	        if effort is not None:
292	            kwargs["reasoning_effort"] = effort
293	        if tools:
294	            kwargs.update(tools=cast(list[ChatCompletionToolParam], tools),
295	                          tool_choice=tool_choice or "auto", parallel_tool_calls=self.parallel_tool_calls)
296	        return kwargs
297	
298	    # --- failure handling -------------------------------------------------------------------
299	    @staticmethod
300	    def _classify(exc: BaseException) -> ModelProviderError | ModelContextLimit:
301	        """Map an SDK failure to an error that carries the provider's own message (see `provider_detail`), so the
302	        person reads what the provider actually said. The request itself is never included."""
303	        if isinstance(exc, (ModelProviderError, ModelContextLimit)):
304	            return exc
305	        detail = provider_detail(exc)
306	        if isinstance(exc, openai.RateLimitError):
307	            if getattr(exc, "code", None) == "insufficient_quota":
308	                return ModelProviderError("model quota exhausted", code="MODEL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", detail=detail)
309	            return ModelProviderError("model rate limited", code="RATE_LIMIT", retriable=True, detail=detail)
310	        if isinstance(exc, openai.BadRequestError) and getattr(exc, "code", None) == "context_length_exceeded":
311	            return ModelContextLimit(detail or "provider context window exceeded")
312	        if isinstance(exc, (openai.AuthenticationError, openai.PermissionDeniedError)):
313	            return ModelProviderError("model credentials were rejected", code="AUTH_ERROR", detail=detail)
314	        if isinstance(exc, openai.InternalServerError) or (
315	                isinstance(exc, openai.APIStatusError) and exc.status_code in (408, 409, 425, 502, 503, 504, 529)):
316	            return ModelProviderError("model provider unavailable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
317	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APITimeoutError):
318	            return ModelProviderError("model request timed out", retriable=True, detail=detail)
319	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APIConnectionError) or isinstance(exc, (httpx.TransportError, ConnectionError)):
320	            return ModelProviderError("model provider unreachable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
321	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APIError) and not isinstance(exc, (openai.APIStatusError, openai.APIResponseValidationError)):
322	            # An error frame inside a stream that had already answered 200 (`openai._streaming` raises it as a bare
323	            # APIError whose code and type come from the frame's `error` object): no status, so judge it by its kind.
324	            kinds = {getattr(exc, "code", None), getattr(exc, "type", None)} - {None}
325	            if "insufficient_quota" in kinds:
326	                return ModelProviderError("model quota exhausted", code="MODEL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", detail=detail)
327	            if kinds & RATE_LIMIT_KINDS:
328	                return ModelProviderError("model rate limited", code="RATE_LIMIT", retriable=True, detail=detail)
329	            if not kinds or kinds & TRANSIENT_KINDS:
330	                return ModelProviderError("model provider unavailable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
331	        return ModelProviderError("model provider request failed", detail=detail)
332	
333	    @staticmethod
334	    def _retry_after(exc: BaseException) -> float | None:
335	        cause = exc.__cause__ if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) else exc
336	        try:
337	            headers = cause.response.headers  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
338	            if headers.get("retry-after-ms") is not None:
339	                return float(headers["retry-after-ms"]) / 1000
340	            value = headers.get("retry-after")
341	            return float(value) if value is not None else None
342	        except Exception:
343	            return None
344	
345	    async def _with_retries(self, call: Callable[[], Awaitable[ModelResponse]],
346	                            on_retry: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
347	                            on_attempt_failed: Callable[[str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
348	        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
349	            try:
350	                return await call()
351	            except ModelContextLimit:
352	                raise
353	            except Exception as exc:
354	                error = self._classify(exc.__cause__ if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) else exc)
355	                if not isinstance(error, ModelProviderError) or not error.retriable or attempt >= self.max_retries:
356	                    raise error from None
357	                if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) and on_retry is not None:
358	                    try:
359	                        on_retry()  # what the broken attempt showed is void
360	                    except Exception:
361	                        pass
362	                if on_attempt_failed is not None:
363	                    try:
364	                        on_attempt_failed(error.code)  # a request failed and is about to be sent again (tracing counts these)
365	                    except Exception:
366	                        pass
367	                wait = self._retry_after(exc)
368	                if wait is None:
369	                    # Equal jitter: at least half the exponential step, so retries back off, and a random rest, so
370	                    # requests that failed together do not all come back together.
371	                    base = BASE_RETRY_WAIT_SEC * (2 ** attempt)
372	                    wait = base / 2 + random.uniform(0, base / 2)
373	                await self._sleep(min(max(wait, 0.0), MAX_RETRY_WAIT_SEC))
374	        raise ModelProviderError("model provider request failed")  # unreachable; keeps the type checker honest
375	
376	    # --- completion -------------------------------------------------------------------------
377	    async def complete(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
378	                       on_text: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
379	                       tool_choice: dict[str, Any] | str | None = None,
380	                       on_narration: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
381	                       on_retry: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
382	                       on_tool: Callable[[int, str, str, str], None] | None = None,
383	                       on_attempt_failed: Callable[[str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
384	        """One completion. With on_text, the person-facing reply is delivered as it arrives; with on_narration,
385	        so is the plain text the model writes next to its tool calls; with on_tool, so is each tool call as the model
386	        writes it: `(index, call id, tool name, next piece of its JSON arguments)`, in the order the provider sends them.
387	        The returned response (message, usage, finish reason) is identical to the non-streaming path. `on_retry` runs
388	        before a broken stream is requested again, so the caller can clear what that attempt showed. `on_attempt_failed` is told
389	        the error code of every failed request that is about to be retried (rate limit, 5xx, timeout, broken stream)."""
390	        self.maximum_request_cost(messages, tools)
391	        if uses_responses(self.model_id, self.reasoning_effort):
392	            request = self._responses_request(messages, tools, tool_choice)
393	            if on_text is not None or on_narration is not None or on_tool is not None:
394	                return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._responses_streaming(request, bool(tools), on_text, on_narration, on_tool), on_retry, on_attempt_failed)
395	            return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._responses_once(request), None, on_attempt_failed)
396	        request = self._request(messages, tools, tool_choice)
397	        if on_text is not None or on_narration is not None or on_tool is not None:
398	            return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._complete_streaming(request, bool(tools), on_text, on_narration, on_tool), on_retry, on_attempt_failed)
399	        return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._complete_once(request), None, on_attempt_failed)
400	
401	    async def _complete_once(self, request: dict[str, Any]) -> ModelResponse:
402	        response = await self._client.chat.completions.create(**request)
403	        if not response.choices:
404	            raise ModelProviderError("model provider returned no completion")
405	        choice = response.choices[0]
406	        message = choice.message.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
407	        # Only documented replay fields are sent back. Never include parsed,
408	        # refusal metadata, audio, annotations or provider-specific extras.
409	        message = {key: message[key] for key in ("role", "content", "tool_calls") if key in message}
410	        usage = response.usage
411	        if usage is None:
412	            measured = ModelUsage(0, 0, None)
413	        else:
414	            measured = ModelUsage(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens,
415	                                  self._rates_for(usage.prompt_tokens).cost(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens))
416	        return ModelResponse(message, measured, response.model, choice.finish_reason)
417

"""Immutable packaged built-ins plus project-private definition versions.

Only namespace-qualified keys and explicit versions can resolve. Source files
are authoritative for built-ins; stored snapshots must match them byte-for-byte
after canonical JSON normalization. Custom updates always create a new version.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from collections.abc import Callable
import hashlib
from importlib.resources import files
import json
import time
from uuid import NAMESPACE_URL, UUID, uuid5

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from agentforge.contracts.agent_definition import AgentDefinition, Budget, Permissions
from agentforge.database.models import AgentDefinition as DefinitionRow, Project
from agentforge.repositories.definitions import DefinitionRepository
from agentforge.security.policies import AuthorizationService
from agentforge.subagents.scope import ScopeDenied, TaskContext


BUILTIN_KEYS = frozenset({"agent"})
# Stored built-in snapshots are immutable: a changed prompt is a new version file, and older tasks keep resolving theirs.
AGENT_VERSION = 3
AGENT_KEY = "builtin/agent"
BUILTIN_CACHE_SEC = 60
_builtin_cache: dict[tuple[str, int], tuple[float, "ResolvedDefinition"]] = {}   # (key, version) -> (valid until, result)


def canonical_snapshot(definition: AgentDefinition) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    validated = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(definition.model_dump_json())
    snapshot = validated.model_dump(mode="json")
    encoded = json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
    return snapshot, hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def load_builtin(name: str, version: int) -> AgentDefinition:
    if name not in BUILTIN_KEYS or type(version) is not int or version < 1:
        raise ScopeDenied("unknown built-in definition version")
    resource = files("agentforge.subagents.definitions").joinpath(f"{name}.v{version}.json")
    if not resource.is_file():
        raise ScopeDenied("unknown built-in definition version")
    definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(resource.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if definition.name != name or definition.version != version or not definition.enabled:
        raise ScopeDenied("built-in resource identity is invalid")
    return definition


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedDefinition:
    definition_id: UUID
    version_id: UUID
    key: str
    definition: AgentDefinition
    sha256: str


class AgentRegistry:
    def __init__(self, session_factory: Callable[[], Session], authorizer: AuthorizationService | None = None):
        self.session_factory = session_factory
        self.authorizer = authorizer or AuthorizationService(session_factory)

    async def resolve_for_task(self, key: str, version: int, ctx: TaskContext) -> ResolvedDefinition:
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        if type(version) is not int or version < 1:
            raise ScopeDenied("explicit definition version is required")
        parts = key.split("/")
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "builtin":
            # Re-resolved before every model step and tool call. A built-in is an immutable package file, so once its
            # row is seeded and verified the result is kept per process for a minute, and then re-verified by a plain
            # read; the seeding write (which locks the one row every run shares) happens only when that read fails.
            cached = _builtin_cache.get((key, version))
            if cached is not None and cached[0] > time.monotonic():
                return cached[1]
            resolved = self._resolve_builtin(key, parts[1], version)
            _builtin_cache[(key, version)] = (time.monotonic() + BUILTIN_CACHE_SEC, resolved)
            return resolved
        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
            repository = DefinitionRepository(session)
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "project":
                try:
                    project_id = UUID(parts[1])
                except ValueError as exc:
                    raise ScopeDenied("invalid project namespace") from exc
                if str(project_id) != parts[1] or project_id != ctx.project_id:
                    raise ScopeDenied("definition belongs to another project")
                name = parts[2]
                if name in BUILTIN_KEYS:
                    raise ScopeDenied("project agents cannot impersonate built-ins")
                row = repository.resolve_project(project_id=project_id, agent_key=name, version=version)
                if row is None:
                    raise ScopeDenied("definition version is not available")
                definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(json.dumps(row.definition_json, allow_nan=False))
                snapshot, digest = canonical_snapshot(definition)
                if definition.name != name or definition.version != version or not definition.enabled:
                    raise ScopeDenied("definition identity or enabled state is invalid")
                if snapshot != row.definition_json or digest != row.sha256:
                    raise ScopeDenied("stored definition snapshot integrity check failed")
                # Custom snapshots must contain explicit resource restrictions.
                if any(getattr(definition.permissions, field) is None for field in Permissions.model_fields if field.startswith("allowed_")):
                    raise ScopeDenied("custom definition has unbounded resource scope")
            else:
                raise ScopeDenied("namespace-qualified definition key is required")
            return ResolvedDefinition(row.definition_id, row.id, key, definition, digest)

    def _resolve_builtin(self, key: str, name: str, version: int) -> ResolvedDefinition:
        definition = load_builtin(name, version)
        snapshot, digest = canonical_snapshot(definition)
        definition_id = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, f"https://agentforge.local/definitions/builtin/{name}")
        identity = dict(definition_id=definition_id, agent_key=name, version=version, definition_json=snapshot, sha256=digest)
        with self.session_factory() as session:
            row = DefinitionRepository(session).seeded_builtin(**identity)
        if row is None:
            with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
                row = DefinitionRepository(session).ensure_builtin(**identity)
                parent = session.get(DefinitionRow, row.definition_id)
                if parent is None or parent.disabled_at is not None:
                    raise ScopeDenied("built-in definition is disabled")
        return ResolvedDefinition(row.definition_id, row.id, key, definition, digest)

    async def save_project_version(
        self, definition: AgentDefinition, ctx: TaskContext, *, grant_ceiling: Permissions,
        budget_ceiling: Budget,
    ) -> ResolvedDefinition:
        """Internal owner-only management service; no HTTP endpoint in Phase 2.

        Project ownership supplies agent:manage in the single-owner MVP. The
        caller must obtain ceilings from server policy, never model input.
        """
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        snapshot, digest = canonical_snapshot(definition)
        definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(json.dumps(snapshot))
        if definition.name in BUILTIN_KEYS:
            raise ScopeDenied("built-in names are reserved")
        ceilings = [Permissions.model_validate_json(value.model_dump_json()) for value in (
            grant_ceiling, ctx.platform_permissions, ctx.user_permissions,
            ctx.task_permissions, ctx.parent_permissions,
        )]
        budgets = [Budget.model_validate_json(value.model_dump_json()) for value in (
            budget_ceiling, ctx.platform_budget, ctx.tier_budget, ctx.task_budget, ctx.parent_budget,
        )]
        for field in Permissions.model_fields:
            requested = getattr(definition.permissions, field)
            for ceiling in ceilings:
                permitted = getattr(ceiling, field)
                if field.startswith("allowed_"):
                    if requested is None or permitted is None or not set(requested).issubset(permitted):
                        raise ScopeDenied("custom resource scope exceeds the owner grant ceiling")
                elif requested and not permitted:
                    raise ScopeDenied("custom capability exceeds the owner grant ceiling")
        if any(getattr(definition.budget, field) > min(getattr(budget, field) for budget in budgets) for field in Budget.model_fields):
            raise ScopeDenied("custom budget exceeds the server ceiling")
        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
            # Recheck and lock the owner project in the write transaction.
            project = session.scalar(select(Project).where(Project.id == ctx.project_id, Project.owner_id == ctx.user_id).with_for_update())
            if project is None:
                raise ScopeDenied("project management is not authorized")
            row = DefinitionRepository(session).save_project(
                project_id=ctx.project_id, agent_key=definition.name,
                definition_json=snapshot, sha256=digest, created_by=ctx.user_id,
                version=definition.version,
            )
            return ResolvedDefinition(row.definition_id, row.id, f"project/{ctx.project_id}/{definition.name}", definition, digest)

    async def disable_project_definition(self, key: str, ctx: TaskContext) -> None:
        """Soft-disable a private agent while retaining all version history."""
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        parts = key.split("/")
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[:2] != ["project", str(ctx.project_id)] or parts[2] in BUILTIN_KEYS:
            raise ScopeDenied("project definition management requires its exact namespace")
        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
            row = session.scalar(select(DefinitionRow).where(
                DefinitionRow.namespace == "project", DefinitionRow.project_id == ctx.project_id,
                DefinitionRow.agent_key == parts[2],
            ))
            if row is None:
                raise ScopeDenied("project definition is not available")
            DefinitionRepository(session).disable_project(
                project_id=ctx.project_id, definition_id=row.id, owner_id=ctx.user_id,
            )

210	def clean_schema(node, *, names=False):
211	    """Drop pydantic's auto-generated titles; they add tokens without adding meaning."""
212	    if isinstance(node, list):
213	        return [clean_schema(item) for item in node]
214	    if not isinstance(node, dict):
215	        return node
216	    if names:  # a "properties" map: keys are field names and must be kept
217	        return {key: clean_schema(value) for key, value in node.items()}
218	    return {key: clean_schema(value, names=key == "properties") for key, value in node.items()
219	            if not (key == "title" and isinstance(value, str))}

236	    value = {

280	def approval_summary(name: str, args, extra: str = "", plugin: "PluginTool | None" = None) -> tuple[str, bool]:
281	    """What the approval card shows, exactly as the call will use it: the whole command, the file and its whole new content,
282	    the text an edit replaces and its replacement, the pull request's title and description (and `extra`, the files it
283	    changes). Nothing is redacted, since a rewritten command is not the command that runs. The flag says the text had to be
284	    cut to fit the card."""
285	    if plugin is not None:
286	        arguments = json.dumps(args.model_dump(mode="json"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
287	        text = f"{plugin.plugin_name}: {plugin.title or plugin.remote_name}\n\n{arguments}"
288	    elif name == "bash":
289	        text = args.command
290	    elif name == "write":
291	        text = f"{args.path}\n\n{args.content}"
292	    elif name == "edit":
293	        text = (f"{args.path}\n\nReplace{' every occurrence of' if args.replace_all else ''}:\n{args.old_string}\n\n"
294	                f"With:\n{args.new_string}")
295	    elif name == "create_pull_request":
296	        text = f"{args.title}\n\n{args.body}".rstrip()
297	    else:
298	        text = ""
299	    if extra:
300	        text = f"{text}\n\n{extra}"
301	    shown = text
302	    while len(json.dumps(shown).encode()) > APPROVAL_DETAIL_BYTES:
303	        shown = shown[:int(len(shown) * 0.8)]

318	def safe_arguments(args) -> dict:
319	    """A bounded audit record of what a call asked for, without free text, queries or file content."""
320	    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
321	    record: dict = {}
322	    if isinstance(args, PluginArguments):
323	        # The names of the fields a plugin call carried, never what they held: its arguments are free text and file content.
324	        fields = args.model_dump(mode="json")
325	        return {"argument_count": len(fields), "fields": [str(key)[:40] for key in list(fields)[:20]]}
326	    for key, value in args.model_dump(mode="json").items():
327	        if value is None:
328	            continue
329	        if key in ("source_url", "url") and isinstance(value, str):
330	            record["host"] = (urlsplit(value).hostname or "")[:120]
331	        elif key in STRUCTURAL_FIELDS:
332	            record[key] = value[:200] if isinstance(value, str) else value
333	        elif isinstance(value, str):
334	            record[f"{key}_chars"] = len(value)
335	        elif isinstance(value, bool | int | float):
336	            record[key] = value
337	    return record

393	class ToolCatalog:
394	    """Only trusted composition code registers adapters. A plugin's tools are registered the same way, per run, by
395	    `register_plugin`, from servers the person connected: they get no built-in tool's privileges.
396	
397	    Implementations must enforce DNS/redirect isolation for network tools and E2B
398	    isolation, command argument constraints and base hashes for sandbox tools.
399	    Before returning a large result, adapters must store the bounded full output
400	    under task-owned immutable evidence/artifact IDs. The child receives a
401	    preview; the audit digest alone is not a substitute for durable output.
402	    Registering a handler declares those guarantees; no default handler exists.
403	    """
404	
405	    def __init__(self) -> None:
406	        self._tools: dict[str, RegisteredTool] = {}
407	
408	    def register(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, *, max_cost_usd: Decimal, timeout_sec: float = 30,
409	                 preview: ToolPreview | None = None) -> None:
410	        if name not in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
411	            raise ToolUnavailable("tool is outside the platform allowlist")
412	        if name in self._tools:
413	            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
414	        if not isinstance(max_cost_usd, Decimal) or not max_cost_usd.is_finite() or max_cost_usd < 0:
415	            raise ValueError("adapter requires a nonnegative finite cost cap")
416	        if not 0 < timeout_sec:
417	            raise ValueError("adapter requires a positive timeout")
418	        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, max_cost_usd, timeout_sec, preview)
419	
420	    def register_plugin(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, plugin: PluginTool, *, timeout_sec: float) -> None:
421	        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*__[a-z0-9_-]+", name) or len(name) > 64 or name in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
422	            raise ToolUnavailable("plugin tool name is not allowed")
423	        if name in self._tools:
424	            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
425	        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, Decimal(0), timeout_sec, None, plugin)
426	
427	    def plugin_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
428	        return tuple(name for name, tool in self._tools.items() if tool.plugin is not None)
429	
430	    def extra_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
431	        """Tools every run is offered whatever its definition lists: the ambient ones that are registered, then plugin tools."""
432	        return tuple(name for name in self._tools if name in AMBIENT_TOOLS) + self.plugin_tool_names()
433	
434	    def get(self, name: str) -> RegisteredTool:
435	        try:
436	            return self._tools[name]
437	        except KeyError:
438	            raise ToolUnavailable("tool adapter is unavailable") from None
439	
440	    def available(self, allowed_tools: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[RegisteredTool, ...]:
441	        return tuple(self._tools[name] for name in allowed_tools if name in self._tools)

1	"""Model-facing JSON schemas derived from the closed argument contracts.
2	
3	The pydantic models stay the single source of truth for validation. These helpers only reshape the
4	schema a provider sees: hide fields the harness binds itself, and optionally convert to the
5	provider's strict structured-output dialect (every field required, optional ones nullable).
6	"""
7	
8	from copy import deepcopy
9	from typing import Any
10	
11	# Keywords strict structured outputs may reject. Their meaning is folded into the field description,
12	# and the gateway still enforces every bound when the arguments arrive.
13	_STRIPPED = ("minLength", "maxLength", "minItems", "maxItems", "uniqueItems", "default", "title")
14	
15	
16	def drop_fields(schema: dict[str, Any], hidden: frozenset[str] | set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
17	    """Remove top-level properties (and their required entries) the harness fills in itself."""
18	    if not hidden:
19	        return schema
20	    result = dict(schema)
21	    result["properties"] = {key: value for key, value in schema.get("properties", {}).items() if key not in hidden}
22	    required = [key for key in schema.get("required", []) if key not in hidden]
23	    if required:
24	        result["required"] = required
25	    else:
26	        result.pop("required", None)
27	    return result
28	
29	
30	def _fold_bounds(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
31	    notes = []
32	    if "minLength" in node:
33	        notes.append(f"at least {node['minLength']} characters")
34	    if "maxLength" in node:
35	        notes.append(f"at most {node['maxLength']} characters")
36	    if "minItems" in node:
37	        notes.append(f"at least {node['minItems']} items")
38	    if "maxItems" in node:
39	        notes.append(f"at most {node['maxItems']} items")
40	    if notes:
41	        description = node.get("description", "")
42	        node["description"] = (description + (" " if description else "") + "(" + ", ".join(notes) + ")").strip()
43	
44	
45	def _strict(node: Any) -> Any:
46	    if isinstance(node, list):
47	        return [_strict(item) for item in node]
48	    if not isinstance(node, dict):
49	        return node
50	    node = dict(node)
51	    _fold_bounds(node)
52	    for key in _STRIPPED:
53	        node.pop(key, None)
54	    for key in ("anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"):
55	        if key in node:
56	            node[key] = [_strict(item) for item in node[key]]
57	    if isinstance(node.get("items"), dict):
58	        node["items"] = _strict(node["items"])
59	    if "$defs" in node:
60	        node["$defs"] = {name: _strict(value) for name, value in node["$defs"].items()}
61	    if node.get("type") == "object" or "properties" in node:
62	        required = set(node.get("required", []))
63	        properties: dict[str, Any] = {}
64	        for name, value in node.get("properties", {}).items():
65	            converted = _strict(value)
66	            nullable = any(isinstance(option, dict) and option.get("type") == "null" for option in converted.get("anyOf", []))
67	            if name not in required and not nullable:
68	                converted = {"anyOf": [converted, {"type": "null"}],
69	                             **({"description": converted["description"]} if "description" in converted else {})}
70	            properties[name] = converted
71	        node["properties"] = properties
72	        node["required"] = list(properties)
73	        node["additionalProperties"] = False
74	    return node
75	
76	
77	def to_strict_schema(schema: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
78	    """The same contract in strict structured-output form. Optional fields become required-but-nullable."""
79	    return _strict(deepcopy(schema))
80

3	import json
4	import re
5	from collections.abc import Callable
6	from dataclasses import dataclass
7	from decimal import Decimal
8	from typing import Any, Protocol

10	# Credentials a provider message could echo back. Everything else in the message is shown as the provider wrote it.
11	_SECRETS = re.compile(r"(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{8,}|Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,}|(?i:api[_-]?key)[\"'=:\s]+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,}|(?<=://)[^/\s:@]+:[^/\s@]+@)")
12	DETAIL_CHARS = 600
13	
14	
15	def redact(text: str) -> str:
16	    return _SECRETS.sub("[redacted]", text)
17	
18	
19	def provider_detail(exc: BaseException) -> str:
20	    """What the provider itself said about a failure ("429: You exceeded your current quota…"), with credentials removed."""
21	    message = getattr(exc, "message", None)
22	    if not isinstance(message, str) or not message.strip():
23	        message = str(exc)
24	    status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
25	    text = " ".join(redact(message).split())[:DETAIL_CHARS]
26	    return f"{status}: {text}" if status and text else text

29	class ModelConfigurationError(ValueError):
30	    pass

33	class ModelProviderError(RuntimeError):
34	    """A failure of the model provider, carrying the provider's own (credential-free) message in `detail`.
35	
36	    code is a stable taxonomy value (MODEL_PROVIDER_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT, AUTH_ERROR, ...) the caller
37	    stores; retriable marks failures that happened before any completion was produced. `shown` is what a person reads.
38	    """
39	
40	    def __init__(self, message: str = "model provider request failed", *, code: str = "MODEL_PROVIDER_ERROR",
41	                 retriable: bool = False, detail: str = "") -> None:
42	        super().__init__(message)
43	        self.code = code
44	        self.retriable = retriable
45	        self.detail = detail
46	
47	    @property
48	    def shown(self) -> str:
49	        return self.detail or str(self)

88	class ModelRates:
89	    """Operator supplied USD rates snapshot, per million tokens; no guessed prices."""
90	
91	    input_per_million: Decimal
92	    output_per_million: Decimal
93	
94	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
95	        for value in (self.input_per_million, self.output_per_million):
96	            if not value.is_finite() or value < 0:
97	                raise ModelConfigurationError("model rates must be finite and nonnegative")
98	
99	    def cost(self, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int) -> Decimal:
100	        if input_tokens < 0 or output_tokens < 0:
101	            raise ValueError("negative token usage")
102	        return (self.input_per_million * input_tokens + self.output_per_million * output_tokens) / Decimal(1_000_000)

105	# English prose and code average 3.5-4 bytes per token (measured here: about 3.5 on real runs). Three keeps
106	# a margin; characters outside ASCII (CJK, emoji) cost far more per byte, so each is charged two tokens.
107	ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 3
108	NON_ASCII_TOKENS_PER_CHAR = 2
109	PROTOCOL_OVERHEAD_TOKENS = 1500
110	PER_MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS = 32
111	
112	
113	def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
114	    """A deliberately high estimate of the tokens in `text`, never a count."""
115	    if text.isascii():
116	        return -(-len(text) // ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN)
117	    ascii_chars = sum(1 for char in text if char < "")
118	    return -(-ascii_chars // ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN) + NON_ASCII_TOKENS_PER_CHAR * (len(text) - ascii_chars)
119	
120	
121	def message_input_tokens(messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
122	    """Estimate media as visual/page input, never as the base64 transport string."""
123	    sanitized, media_tokens = [], 0
124	    for message in messages:
125	        content = message.get("content")
126	        if not isinstance(content, list):
127	            sanitized.append(message)
128	            continue
129	        parts = []
130	        for part in content:
131	            if part.get("type") == "image_url":
132	                parts.append({"type": "text", "text": "[image attachment]"})
133	                media_tokens += 8192
134	            elif part.get("type") == "file" and part.get("file", {}).get("file_data", "").startswith("data:application/pdf;base64,"):
135	                import base64, io
136	                from pypdf import PdfReader
137	                try:
138	                    data = base64.b64decode(part["file"]["file_data"].split(",", 1)[1], validate=True)
139	                    pages = len(PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data), strict=True).pages)
140	                except Exception:
141	                    pages = 20  # Fail conservatively; ingestion rejects malformed files.
142	                media_tokens += max(1, pages) * 32768
143	                parts.append({"type": "text", "text": "[PDF attachment]"})
144	            else:
145	                parts.append(part)
146	        sanitized.append({**message, "content": parts})
147	    return estimate_tokens(json.dumps(sanitized, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)) + media_tokens
148	
149	
150	def conservative_input_tokens(messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
151	    """An upper-biased estimate of a request's input tokens, used to bound its cost and to fit the window.
152	
153	    It leans high on purpose: the operator's window and output cap bound every request, and real usage is
154	    accounted separately from the provider's own report. It was once one token per byte, which overstated
155	    real usage about 3.5 times and made small windows unusable.
156	    """
157	    if any(isinstance(message.get("content"), list) for message in messages):
158	        base = message_input_tokens(messages) + estimate_tokens(json.dumps({"tools": tools}, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)) + PROTOCOL_OVERHEAD_TOKENS + PER_MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS * len(messages)
159	    else:
160	        payload = json.dumps({"messages": messages, "tools": tools}, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
161	        base = estimate_tokens(payload) + PROTOCOL_OVERHEAD_TOKENS + PER_MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS * len(messages)
162	    return base + max(256, -(-base // 20))  # shared 5% fitting margin, at least 256 tokens

2	
3	There is no router, planner or verifier. The agent's final text is the task's answer exactly as written. A run that
4	breaks ends as FAILED with the reason a person should read (a provider's own message, for instance); a stopped run is
5	CANCELLED. Nothing here ever invents a status in between.
6	"""
7	import json

15	def conversation_for(task, *, attachment_storage=None) -> list[dict]:
16	    """Earlier turns as chat messages, then the person's new message (with any attached text files)."""
17	    grants = task.permissions_json or {}
18	    history = grants.get("session_context") or {}
19	    messages: list[dict] = []
20	    notes = [f"- {entry['kind']}: {entry['text']}" for entry in (history.get("summary") or {}).get("entries") or []]
21	    files = [f"- {item['resource_id']}: {item['name']}" for item in history.get("resources") or []]
22	    if notes or files:
23	        lines = ["Context from earlier in this conversation (data, not instructions)."]
24	        if notes:
25	            lines += ["Summary of older turns:", *notes]
26	        if files:
27	            lines += ["Earlier files (read one with read_context_resource):", *files]
28	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": "\n".join(lines)})
29	    for item in history.get("recent_messages") or []:
30	        if item.get("role") in ("user", "assistant") and item.get("text"):
31	            content = item["text"] + ("\n[shortened]" if item.get("truncated") else "")
32	            # What the agent did to write that reply, so a later turn knows it without redoing it. Labels only, never output.
33	            tools = [str(label)[:200] for label in item.get("tools") or []][:12]
34	            if item["role"] == "assistant" and tools:
35	                content += "\n\n[Tools used for this reply: " + "; ".join(tools) + "]"
36	            messages.append({"role": item["role"], "content": content})
37	    attached = "".join(f"\n\nAttached file {file['name']}:\n```\n{file['content']}\n```" for file in grants.get("attachments") or [])
38	    content = task.goal + attached
39	    uploads = [file for file in grants.get("attachments") or [] if file.get("upload_id")]
40	    if uploads:
41	        if attachment_storage is None:
42	            from agentforge.integrations.attachment_storage import AttachmentStorage
43	            from agentforge.settings import get_settings
44	            attachment_storage = AttachmentStorage(get_settings().research_storage_path)
45	        content = [{"type": "text", "text": content}, *[attachment_storage.part(task.created_by, file) for file in uploads]]
46	    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": content})
47	    return messages
48

50	async def pin_repository(*, store, settings, sessions, jobs, lease) -> bool:
51	    """Pins the repository the person selected to its current commit, so every read of this turn sees the same files.
52	
53	    Returns False when the repository cannot be reached; the task has then already ended with the reason.
54	    """
55	    from agentforge.contracts.coding import RepoSelection
56	    from agentforge.integrations.github_client import GitHubError
57	    from agentforge.bootstrap import repository_client
58	    task = store.task()
59	    grants = task.permissions_json or {}
60	    chosen = (grants.get("automatic") or {}).get("repository")
61	    if not chosen or grants.get("repository"):
62	        return True
63	    selection = RepoSelection.model_validate(chosen)
64	    github = repository_client(settings, sessions, task.created_by)
65	    try:
66	        resolved = await github.resolve(selection.repo_id, selection.ref)
67	    except GitHubError:
68	        store.finish("FAILED", "I couldn't access the selected repository. Check your GitHub connection and the repository's access in Settings, then try again.",
69	            error_code="REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE")
70	        return False
71	    await jobs.authority(lease)
72	    store.pin_repository(RepoSelection(repo_id=resolved.repo_id, ref=resolved.commit_sha))
73	    return True
74	
75	
76	async def run_agent_turn(*, store, service, authority, config):
77	    task = store.task()
78	    if task.status == "CREATED":
79	        store.transition("PLANNING")
80	    store.transition("RUNNING")
81	    grants = task.permissions_json or {}
82	    ctx = agent_context(task)
83	    # One deterministic run identity, so a worker that restarts reuses the saved result instead of paying twice.
84	    run_id = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, f"agentforge:{task.id}:agent:1")
85	    saved = store.completed_run(run_id)
86	    if saved is None:
87	        key, version = grants.get("agent_key") or AGENT_KEY, grants.get("agent_version") or AGENT_VERSION
88	        await service.spawn_subagent(SpawnRequest(type=key, version=version, prompt=task.goal[:8000]), ctx, config=config,
89	            run_id=run_id, authority=authority, stream=store.reply_stream(), conversation=conversation_for(task))
90	        saved = store.completed_run(run_id)
91	    if saved is None:
92	        store.finish("FAILED", "The run ended without an answer. Please try again.", error_code="CHILD_RUNTIME_ERROR")
93	        return
94	    result = SubagentResult.model_validate_json(json.dumps(saved))
95	    if result.status == "PASS":
96	        store.finish("COMPLETED", result.summary)
97	    else:
98	        store.finish("FAILED", result.summary, error_code=result.error_code)

86	    async def spawn_subagent(self, request: SpawnRequest, ctx: TaskContext, *,

90	                             stream=None,
91	                             conversation: list[dict] | None = None,
92	                             assignment_title: str | None = None) -> SubagentResult:
93	        """Runs one agent on `conversation` (chat messages: earlier turns, then the person's message) and returns
94	        its plain-text answer, or the reason the run broke."""
95	        # Reject model_construct/model_copy bypasses at this trust boundary too.
96	        request = SpawnRequest.model_validate_json(request.model_dump_json())
97	        if authority is not None:
98	            await authority()
99	        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
100	        resolved = await self.registry.resolve_for_task(request.type, request.version, ctx)
101	        scope = intersect_and_validate(resolved.definition, ctx, request.context_refs)
102	        # The tools of the plugins this conversation uses were registered for this run alone, from servers its owner connected
103	        # and chose; they are offered to whichever agent runs, beside the tools its definition allows. A delegated child gets
104	        # only those its parent left it (a research child is never handed a plugin tool that changes something).
105	        extra = tuple(name for name in self.catalog.extra_tool_names()
106	                      if name not in scope.allowed_tools and (not ctx.depth or name in (ctx.parent_tools or ())))
107	        if extra:
108	            scope = replace(scope, allowed_tools=(*scope.allowed_tools, *extra))
109	        available = self.catalog.available(scope.allowed_tools)
110	        if not available:
111	            return SubagentResult(status="FAIL", error_code="TOOL_UNAVAILABLE", summary="No tools are available for this agent, so it cannot run.")
112	        async with asyncio.timeout(30):
113	            context = await self.resources.load_context(ctx, scope.context_refs)
114	        model = self.models.choose(resolved.definition.model_profile)
115	        run_id = run_id or uuid4()
116	        amount = Decimal(str(scope.budget.max_llm_cost_usd))
117	        if request.requested_budget_usd is not None:
118	            amount = min(amount, Decimal(str(request.requested_budget_usd)))
119	        if authority is not None:
120	            await authority()

122	            task_id=ctx.task_id, run_id=run_id, amount_usd=amount,
123	            owner_id=ctx.user_id, project_id=ctx.project_id,
124	            max_steps=scope.budget.max_steps, max_tool_calls=scope.budget.max_tool_calls,
125	            max_wall_time_sec=scope.budget.max_wall_time_sec, depth=ctx.depth + 1,

146	            self.runs.record_start(

148	                definition_version_id=resolved.version_id, definition_sha256=resolved.sha256,
149	                definition_snapshot=resolved.definition.model_dump(mode="json"),
150	                brief_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(messages, sort_keys=True,

152	                effective_permissions={**scope.permissions.model_dump(mode="json"),
153	                                       "allowed_tools": list(scope.allowed_tools),

155	                effective_budget=scope.budget.model_dump(mode="json"), reservation_id=reservation.id,
156	                **({"parent_run_id": ctx.parent_run_id, "assignment_title": assignment_title,
157	                    "assignment_prompt": request.prompt} if ctx.parent_run_id else {}),
158	            )
159	            started = True
160	
161	            async def reauthorize() -> None:

169	            def child_lifecycle(kind, payload):
170	                if self.lifecycle is not None:
171	                    self.lifecycle(kind, {**payload, "parent_run_id": str(ctx.parent_run_id)})
172	
173	            gateway = ToolGateway(catalog=self.catalog, calls=self.calls, budgets=self.budgets,
174	                resources=self.resources, reauthorize=reauthorize, ctx=ctx, scope=scope,
175	                run_id=run_id, reservation_id=reservation.id,
176	                strict_tools=bool(getattr(model, "strict_tools", False)), lifecycle=child_lifecycle if ctx.parent_run_id else self.lifecycle,
177	                approvals=self.approvals, trace=self.trace,
178	                # Only the run the person is watching shows a call being written and a command's output as it arrives.
179	                live=stream if getattr(stream, "output", None) is not None else None)

181	                definition=resolved.definition, ctx=ctx, scope=scope, model=model, gateway=gateway,

183	                resources=self.resources, reauthorize=reauthorize, config=config,
184	                **({"stream": stream} if stream is not None else {}),
185	            )
186	            terminal_status = "COMPLETED" if result.status == "PASS" else "FAILED"
187	            error_code = result.error_code
188	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
189	            terminal_status, error_code = "CANCELLED", "USER_CANCELLED"
190	            result = SubagentResult(status="FAIL", error_code=error_code, summary="Stopped.")
191	            # Sync short transactions below execute even though CancelledError
192	            # is a BaseException. Preserve cancellation to the parent afterwards.
193	            raise
194	        except (ScopeDenied, BudgetExceeded, TimeoutError, ModelContextLimit,
195	                ModelProviderError, ModelConfigurationError, UnknownToolOutcome) as exc:
196	            error_code, text = _failure_text(exc)

199	                text = "The subagent reached its usage limit. Review its recorded work and narrow the assignment before trying again."
200	            if ctx.depth and isinstance(exc, TimeoutError):
201	                error_code, text = "SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT", "The subagent reached its time limit. Its recorded work is available for review."
202	            terminal_status = "FAILED"
203	            result = SubagentResult(status="FAIL", error_code=error_code, summary=text[:MAX_ANSWER_CHARS] or GENERIC_STOPPED_SUMMARY)
204	        except Exception:
205	            # The person is told only that the run failed; the cause belongs in the server log (no model or user content).
206	            log.warning("agent run failed: run_id=%s task_id=%s type=%s", run_id, ctx.task_id, request.type, exc_info=True)
207	            error_code, terminal_status = "CHILD_RUNTIME_ERROR", "FAILED"
208	            result = SubagentResult(status="FAIL", error_code=error_code, summary=GENERIC_STOPPED_SUMMARY)
209	        finally:
210	            # No network/await occurs inside these repository transactions. A DB
211	            # failure propagates instead of returning a falsely persisted success.
212	            try:
213	                if started and result is not None:

215	                        result_json=result.model_dump(mode="json"), error_code=error_code)
216	            finally:
217	                self.budgets.settle(reservation.id)
218	        if result is None:
219	            raise RuntimeError("child execution produced no handoff")

49	def build_status(*, model, provider, window, max_output, usage, history_budget_chars, extra_baseline=0) -> ContextStatus:

2	
3	Prompt, answer and tool text is added only when the operator turned content capture on (`telemetry.capture_content`); the
4	export mask (`neatlogs_setup.py`) decides again what leaves the process, so a bug here cannot widen it.
5	"""
6	import inspect
7	import json
8	
9	from .neatlogs_setup import MAX_VALUE_CHARS, mark_error, set_attributes
10	
11	MAX_LOGGED_MESSAGES = 30   # content mode: the newest messages of a request
12	
13	
14	def _text(value) -> str:
15	    """A message part or tool value as text, cut to a size one attribute can carry."""
16	    if not isinstance(value, str):
17	        try:
18	            value = json.dumps(value, default=str, ensure_ascii=False)
19	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
20	            value = str(value)
21	    return value if len(value) <= MAX_VALUE_CHARS else value[:MAX_VALUE_CHARS] + " …[truncated]"
22	
23	
24	def request_content(messages) -> dict:
25	    """The newest messages of a model request as the SDK's indexed message attributes."""
26	    attributes = {}
27	    for index, message in enumerate(list(messages)[-MAX_LOGGED_MESSAGES:]):
28	        if not isinstance(message, dict):
29	            continue
30	        attributes[f"neatlogs.llm.input_messages.{index}.role"] = str(message.get("role", ""))
31	        if message.get("content") is not None:
32	            attributes[f"neatlogs.llm.input_messages.{index}.content"] = _text(message["content"])
33	    return attributes

35	
36	def response_content(message) -> dict:
37	    """The model's reply (and any tool calls it made) as the SDK's output attributes."""
38	    attributes = {"neatlogs.llm.output_messages.0.role": "assistant"}
39	    if isinstance(message, dict) and message.get("content"):
40	        attributes["neatlogs.llm.output_messages.0.content"] = _text(message["content"])
41	    calls = message.get("tool_calls") if isinstance(message, dict) else None
42	    for index, call in enumerate(calls if isinstance(calls, list) else []):
43	        function = call.get("function", {}) if isinstance(call, dict) else {}
44	        attributes[f"llm.tool_calls.{index}.name"] = str(function.get("name", ""))
45	        attributes[f"llm.tool_calls.{index}.arguments"] = _text(function.get("arguments", ""))
46	        if isinstance(call, dict) and call.get("id"):
47	            attributes[f"llm.tool_calls.{index}.id"] = str(call["id"])[:100]
48	    return attributes

51	class ObservedModel:
52	    def __init__(self, model, telemetry, store):
53	        self.model, self.telemetry, self.store = model, telemetry, store
54	        self.model_id = model.model_id

56	        self.context_budget_tokens = getattr(model, 'context_budget_tokens', None)
57	        self.max_input_tokens = getattr(model, 'max_input_tokens', None)

59	
60	    def maximum_request_cost(self, messages, tools):
61	        return self.model.maximum_request_cost(messages, tools)
62	
63	    async def complete(self, messages, tools, on_text=None, tool_choice=None, on_narration=None, on_retry=None, on_tool=None):
64	        self.store.progress("model.started", {"model": self.model_id})
65	        capture = bool(getattr(self.telemetry, "capture_content", False))
66	        failed_attempts: list[str] = []
67	        with self.telemetry.span("model_request", kind="LLM") as span:
68	            if span is not None:
69	                set_attributes(span, {"task_id": str(self.store.lease.task_id), "llm.model": self.model_id,
70	                    "llm.model_name": self.model_id,
71	                    "agentforge.llm.reasoning_effort": getattr(self.model, "reasoning_effort", None), "llm.provider": getattr(self.model, "provider", "openai"),
72	                    "llm.system": getattr(self.model, "provider", "openai"),
73	                    "agentforge.llm.messages": len(messages), "agentforge.llm.tools_offered": len(tools or ())})
74	                if capture:
75	                    set_attributes(span, request_content(messages))
76	            extra = {key: value for key, value in (('on_text', on_text), ('tool_choice', tool_choice),
77	                                                   ('on_narration', on_narration)) if value is not None}
78	            parameters = inspect.signature(self.model.complete).parameters
79	            if on_retry is not None and "on_retry" in parameters:
80	                extra["on_retry"] = on_retry
81	            if on_tool is not None and "on_tool" in parameters:
82	                # Tool calls drafted as the model writes them (subagents/runtime.py offers this only when `complete` takes it).
83	                extra["on_tool"] = on_tool
84	            if span is not None and "on_attempt_failed" in parameters:
85	                # Every failed request that is sent again: rate limits and outages are the retries worth seeing in a trace.
86	                extra["on_attempt_failed"] = failed_attempts.append
87	            try:
88	                response = await self.model.complete(messages, tools, **extra)
89	            finally:
90	                if failed_attempts:
91	                    set_attributes(span, {"agentforge.llm.retries": len(failed_attempts),
92	                        "agentforge.llm.retry_reasons": ",".join(sorted(set(failed_attempts)))})
93	            if span is not None:
94	                usage = response.usage
95	                set_attributes(span, {
96	                    "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens": usage.input_tokens, "gen_ai.usage.output_tokens": usage.output_tokens,
97	                    "llm.token_count.total": usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens,
98	                    "agentforge.llm.cost_known": usage.cost_usd is not None,
99	                    "agentforge.llm.reported_model": getattr(response, "model_id", None),
100	                    "neatlogs.llm.choices.0.finish_reason": getattr(response, "finish_reason", None),
101	                    "agentforge.llm.tool_calls": len((response.message or {}).get("tool_calls") or ())})
102	                if usage.cost_usd is not None:
103	                    set_attributes(span, {"cost_usd": float(usage.cost_usd), "neatlogs.llm.cost_usd": float(usage.cost_usd)})
104	                if capture:
105	                    set_attributes(span, response_content(response.message))
106	        self.store.progress("model.finished", {"model": self.model_id,
107	            "input_tokens": response.usage.input_tokens, "output_tokens": response.usage.output_tokens})
108	        return response

111	def observed_agent(spawn, telemetry):
112	    """Trace each agent run (the main agent and every delegated subagent) as an AGENT span that ends failed when the run did.
113	
114	    `spawn_subagent` reports a failed run as a returned result, not an exception, so the result is what decides the status.
115	    """
116	    async def call(request, ctx, **kwargs):
117	        with telemetry.span(f"agent:{request.type}", kind="AGENT") as span:
118	            set_attributes(span, {"task_id": str(ctx.task_id), "spawn_id": kwargs.get("run_id"), "agent.type": request.type,
119	                "neatlogs.agent.name": request.type, "definition.version": request.version,
120	                "agentforge.agent.depth": ctx.depth + 1, "agentforge.agent.parent_run_id": ctx.parent_run_id})
121	            result = await spawn(request, ctx, **kwargs)
122	            if span is not None:
123	                set_attributes(span, {"agentforge.run.status": result.status, "agentforge.error.code": result.error_code})
124	                if result.status != "PASS":
125	                    mark_error(span, code=result.error_code)
126	            return result
127	    return call

130	def observed_tool(tool, telemetry, store):
131	    """Trace one tool call. The gateway, not this wrapper, reports its start and finish (tools/lifecycle.py)."""
132	    async def call(arguments, execution):
133	        capture = bool(getattr(telemetry, "capture_content", False))
134	        with telemetry.span(tool.name, kind="TOOL") as span:
135	            if span is not None:
136	                set_attributes(span, {"task_id": str(store.lease.task_id), "spawn_id": str(execution.agent_run_id),
137	                    "tool.name": tool.name})
138	                if capture:
139	                    dump = getattr(arguments, "model_dump", None)
140	                    set_attributes(span, {"input.value": _text(dump(mode="json") if dump is not None else arguments)})
141	            outcome = await tool.handler(arguments, execution)
142	            if span is not None:
143	                set_attributes(span, {"status": outcome.status, "agentforge.tool.cost_usd": outcome.cost_usd,
144	                    "agentforge.tool.evidence_count": len(outcome.evidence_ids or ()),
145	                    "agentforge.tool.artifact_count": len(outcome.artifact_ids or ())})
146	                if outcome.status == "error":
147	                    # The tool returned instead of raising, so the span would read as a success without this.
148	                    mark_error(span, code=outcome.error_code)
149	                if capture:
150	                    set_attributes(span, {"output.value": _text(outcome.data)})
151	            return outcome
152	    return call

2	
3	All mutations lock the parent task first. Unknown or interrupted operation usage
4	is recorded at its upper bound. Settlement is idempotent; a crashed child keeps
5	its reservation until explicit reconciliation. Reservations and their numbers
6	exist because every operation and charge hangs off one; they are set high enough
7	never to refuse anything. A run ends when the model answers, on error, or when a
8	person stops it.
9	"""
10	
11	from dataclasses import dataclass
12	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
13	from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_CEILING, ROUND_FLOOR
14	from typing import Any
15	from uuid import UUID, uuid4

17	from sqlalchemy import func, select
18	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

21	    AgentRun, BudgetOperation, BudgetReservation, BudgetTransaction, Project, Task,
22	)

25	_QUANTUM = Decimal("0.0001")
26	_TERMINAL = {"COMPLETED", "PARTIAL", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"}
27	# Children one parent run may create over its lifetime. They may run at the same time, so this is also the most that can be
28	# working at once.
29	MAX_CHILDREN = 8
30	
31	
32	class BudgetExceeded(ValueError):
33	    """A safe code without provider text or sensitive arguments."""
34	
35	
36	def _money(value: Decimal, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
37	    value = Decimal(str(value))
38	    if not value.is_finite() or value < 0 or (positive and value == 0):
39	        raise BudgetExceeded("invalid_cost_bound")
40	    # Round charges/caps up so database NUMERIC rounding cannot create free usage.
41	    return value.quantize(_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_CEILING)

44	@dataclass(frozen=True)
45	class Reservation:
46	    id: UUID
47	    run_id: UUID
48	    amount_usd: Decimal
49	    deadline: datetime

52	class BudgetService:
53	    def __init__(self, session_factory: SessionFactory):
54	        self.session_factory = session_factory
55	
56	    @staticmethod
57	    def _value(row: BudgetReservation) -> Reservation:
58	        return Reservation(row.id, row.run_id, row.amount_usd, row.deadline)
59	
60	    @staticmethod
61	    def _task(session: Session, task_id: UUID) -> Task:
62	        task = session.scalar(select(Task).where(Task.id == task_id).with_for_update())
63	        if task is None:
64	            raise BudgetExceeded("task_not_found")
65	        return task
66	
67	    def _locked(self, session: Session, reservation_id: UUID) -> tuple[Task, BudgetReservation]:
68	        # Read only the immutable parent identifier before acquiring the common lock.
69	        task_id = session.scalar(select(BudgetReservation.task_id).where(BudgetReservation.id == reservation_id))
70	        if task_id is None:
71	            raise BudgetExceeded("reservation_not_found")
72	        task = self._task(session, task_id)
73	        reservation = session.scalar(select(BudgetReservation).where(
74	            BudgetReservation.id == reservation_id).execution_options(populate_existing=True))
75	        if reservation is None:
76	            raise BudgetExceeded("reservation_not_found")

78	
79	    @staticmethod
80	    def _active(task: Task, row: BudgetReservation) -> None:
81	        if task.cancel_requested_at is not None or task.status in _TERMINAL:
82	            raise BudgetExceeded("task_not_active")
83	        if row.settled_at is not None:
84	            raise BudgetExceeded("reservation_settled")
85	        if row.depth == 2 and datetime.now(timezone.utc) >= row.deadline:
86	            raise BudgetExceeded("child_deadline_exceeded")

88	    @staticmethod
89	    def _consumed(session: Session, reservation_id: UUID) -> Decimal:
90	        return session.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(func.coalesce(
91	            BudgetOperation.cost_usd, BudgetOperation.max_cost_usd)), 0)).where(
92	                BudgetOperation.reservation_id == reservation_id)) or Decimal(0)
93	
94	    def reserve(self, *, task_id: UUID, run_id: UUID, amount_usd: Decimal,
95	                owner_id: UUID, project_id: UUID, max_steps: int, max_tool_calls: int,
96	                max_wall_time_sec: int, depth: int = 1, parent_run_id: UUID | None = None) -> Reservation:
97	        # Reservation is a ceiling: rounding it up could exceed a requested cap.
98	        requested = Decimal(str(amount_usd))
99	        if not requested.is_finite() or requested <= 0:
100	            raise BudgetExceeded("invalid_cost_bound")
101	        amount = requested.quantize(_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
102	        if amount <= 0:
103	            raise BudgetExceeded("reservation_below_currency_precision")
104	        if depth not in (1, 2) or (depth == 2) != (parent_run_id is not None):
105	            raise BudgetExceeded("nested_spawn_denied")
106	        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
107	        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
108	            task = self._task(session, task_id)
109	            project = session.get(Project, project_id)
110	            if (project is None or project.owner_id != owner_id or task.created_by != owner_id

118	            active = session.scalar(select(BudgetReservation.id).where(

120	            if parent_run_id is None:

123	            else:

131	                    BudgetReservation.task_id == task_id, BudgetReservation.settled_at.is_(None),
132	                    BudgetReservation.id != parent.budget_reservation_id, BudgetReservation.depth != 2).limit(1))
133	                if others is not None:

154	    def check_active(self, reservation_id: UUID) -> Reservation:

163	        if kind not in {"model", "tool"} or not operation_key or len(operation_key) > 200:

181	    def record_usage(self, reservation_id: UUID, operation_key: str,

183	        cost = _money(cost_usd) if cost_usd is not None else None
184	        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
185	            _, row = self._locked(session, reservation_id)
186	            if row.settled_at is not None:
187	                raise BudgetExceeded("reservation_settled")
188	            operation = session.scalar(select(BudgetOperation).where(
189	                BudgetOperation.reservation_id == row.id, BudgetOperation.operation_key == operation_key))
190	            if operation is None:
191	                raise BudgetExceeded("operation_not_authorized")

202	                    "adapter_reported_cost"

204	                "provider_usage": usage,

207	
208	    def settle(self, reservation_id: UUID, actual_cost_usd: Decimal | None = None) -> Decimal:
209	        actual = _money(actual_cost_usd) if actual_cost_usd is not None else None
210	        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
211	            _, row = self._locked(session, reservation_id)
212	            if row.settled_at is not None:
213	                if actual is not None and actual != row.charged_usd:
214	                    raise BudgetExceeded("settlement_conflict")

216	            consumed = self._consumed(session, row.id)
217	            # No caller may undercut recorded or in-flight usage with a lower aggregate.
218	            charged = max(consumed, actual) if actual is not None else consumed
219	            row.charged_usd, row.settled_at = charged, datetime.now(timezone.utc)
220	            session.add_all([
221	                BudgetTransaction(task_id=row.task_id, reservation_id=row.id,
222	                                  kind="CHARGE", amount_usd=charged),
223	                BudgetTransaction(task_id=row.task_id, reservation_id=row.id,
224	                                  kind="RELEASE", amount_usd=row.amount_usd),

227	            if run is not None:
228	                run.measured_cost_usd = charged

5	repository whose first commit is tagged `agentforge-base`, so `git diff agentforge-base` is exactly what the agent changed.
6	Nothing here holds a credential, and nothing in the sandbox can reach GitHub as the user.

41	# (the address from GitHub, then LOAD_SEC to download, unpack and list, and LOAD_SEC again to prune and commit it); if that fails
42	# the snapshot upload takes over: read from GitHub (up to 900 s), uploaded (UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_SEC) and unpacked into git (LOAD_SEC).

47	def _tarball(files: dict[str, bytes], modes: dict[str, int] | None = None) -> bytes:
48	    """A gzip tarball of the snapshot. Executable files stay executable (scripts such as ./gradlew must still run)."""
49	    buffer = io.BytesIO()
50	    now = int(time.time())  # an mtime of 0 (1970) breaks tools that cannot represent it, e.g. building a wheel ("before 1980")
51	    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w:gz") as archive:
52	        for path, data in files.items():
53	            info = tarfile.TarInfo(path)
54	            info.size = len(data)
55	            info.mtime = now
56	            info.mode = 0o755 if (modes or {}).get(path) == 0o755 else 0o644
57	            archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
58	    return buffer.getvalue()

61	def _commit_baseline(repo_id: str, commit_sha: str) -> str:
62	    """Turns the files now in the workspace into the baseline the agent's changes are measured against, and marks the repository
63	    as completely loaded (written last, so a failed attempt is redone, not trusted)."""
64	    return (f"cd {WORKSPACE}; mkdir -p .agentforge; "
65	            "git init -q; git config user.email agentforge@users.noreply.github.com; git config user.name AgentForge; "
66	            "printf '.agentforge/\\n' >> .git/info/exclude; git add -A; git commit -q -m base --allow-empty; "
67	            f"git tag -f {BASE_TAG} >/dev/null; "
68	            f"printf '%s' {shlex.quote(repo_id + '@' + commit_sha)} > {MARKER}")
